fields.FIR_Description: During the afternoon of 2026-04-29, around 15:50, a message about KYC expiry led the complainant to a website where account credentials were entered, and Rs. 32,000 was transferred out, according to the complaint recorded on 2026-04-29. The online submission was made by Malathi Murugan (9000000027). A further person, Murugan Sundaram, a relative of the suspect, using the number 9000000207, is stated to be associated with the incident. The account reference SYN-ACC-100061 linked to the complainant was mentioned in relation to the transactions. Elango Krishnan (9000000081) noticed the incident and may be able to provide a statement. A person named Logesh Karuppasamy, associated with the number 9000000198, was mentioned as potentially relevant to the incident. Items referenced in the complaint: transaction records and digital documents.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Victim reported receiving a suspicious link that imitated a bank notification.
fields.Keywords: phishing, suspicious link, mobile number, witness, associate, bank account, digital document, main street
